 : Mr. Rajeev Ranjan, Advocate
 For the Respondent/s : Mr. Anand Mohan Prasad Mehta, App
 For the Informant : Mr. Ravi Shankar Sahay, Advocate
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Chandra Shekhar Jha
 Oral Order
4 10-11-2023 Heard learned Advocate Mr. Ajay Kumar Thakur for the accused/appellant, Mr. Ravi Shankar Sahay, for the informant and Mr. Anand Mohan Prasad Mehta, learned APP for the respondent-State.

2. After a short argument learned counsel for accused/appellant submitted that matter relates to conviction under Section 376 of IPC read with Section 4 of the POCSO Act, where disposal of appeal is a mandate within six (06) months after filing, in view of Section 374(4) of Cr.P.C.
3.

In view of submissions, office is directed to list this matter for final hearing immediately after the diwali vacations and if for any reason appeal is not taken up for final hearing within next two months, learned counsel appearing on behalf of Patna High Court CR.

APP (SJ) No.3293 of 2023(4)
dt.10-11-2023 the accused/appellant shall be at liberty to file separate application for considering prayer of bail and suspension of sentence on the grounds of available merit.

4. At this stage, learned counsel for the informant requested for fixing a particular date in this matter and same not being objected by learned counsel for the accused/appellant also.
